notes.title: Demo v0.3.56 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]General updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] SFX/BGM improvements
[*] UI/UX improvements
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
[b]Kitties system:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the spaceship will drop a kitty box every 5 levels of Meow
[*] Kitties rarity from the kitty box will be determined based on Meow's level
[*] Now the unique weapon and active skill of Beck can be evolved if you have 4 orange unions
[/list]
[b]Bosses:[/b]
[list]
[*] Add boss HP bar
[*] Increase the size of all bosses
[*] Temporarily remove the laser dog boss due to its overwhelming difficulty
[/list]
[b]Buffs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Critical rate: 2% > 5%
[*] Attack Speed: 2% > 5%
[/list]
